## Learnings (3)

- **Mjaffle-data-coverage** (`demo_database.orders.ordered_at`): Order data starts on 2022-09-19 (Philadelphia opened 2022-09-26), so 2022 is a partial year. The latest data is usually mid-month: check ordered_at:max before any "this month / this year / YTD" question. Treat the current month as incomplete (whole_periods_only: true). Compare year-to-date against the same calendar cut-off in the prior year, never against the full prior year. Stores that opened mid-period (e.g. Los Angeles, Oct 2025) have small samples; flag this when they top a ranking.
- **Mjaffle-money-in-cents** (`demo_database.orders.order_total`, `demo_database.orders.subtotal`, `demo_database.orders.tax_paid`): Money is stored as **integer cents**. On `orders` the columns `subtotal`, `tax_paid`, and `order_total` are cents; so are `products.price` and `supplies.cost`. Do not `sum` these raw columns for a dollar figure. Use the `dollars` aggregation (`order_total:dollars`) or the pre-built dollar measures (`total_revenue`, `net_sales`, `tax_collected`, `avg_order_value`), which divide by 100.
- **Mjaffle-new-customers** (`demo_database.orders.customer`, `demo_database.orders.ordered_at`, `demo_database.orders.unique_customers`): A new customer in period P is a customer whose first-ever order (ordered_at:min per orders.customer) falls in P. This takes a two-stage query. Stage 1 (name it first_orders): source orders, dimensions [customer], measures [{name: first_order_at, formula: ordered_at:min}]. Stage 2: source first_orders, measures [*:count], filters first_order_at >= start of P and < end of P. Returning customers in P = unique_customers in P minus new customers in P. To count distinct buyers, always use the unique_customers measure (customer:count_distinct), not order rows.

- **Mjaffle-new-customers** (`demo_database.customers`): A new customer in period P is a customer whose first-ever order (ordered_at:min per orders.customer) falls in P. This takes a two-stage query. Stage 1 (name it first_orders): source orders, dimensions [customer], measures [{name: first_order_at, formula: ordered_at:min}]. SQL:
WITH _base_2 AS (
  SELECT
    customers.id AS "customers.id"
  FROM customers AS customers
  GROUP BY
    customers.id
), _cm_customers__tweets__iif_tweeted_at_2025_01_01_00_536f3dbe_0_00_1_0_sum AS (
  SELECT
    tweets.user_id AS "tweets.user_id",
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN tweets.tweeted_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        AND tweets.tweeted_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS "tweets.iif_tweeted_at_2025_01_01_00_536f3dbe_0_00_1_0_sum"
  FROM tweets AS tweets
  GROUP BY
    tweets.user_id
), _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_69aa264b_0_00_1_0_sum AS (
  SELECT
    orders.customer AS "orders.customer",
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS "orders.iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_69aa264b_0_00_1_0_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    orders.customer
), _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_5aa1dcc7_btotal_0_sum AS (
  SELECT
    orders.customer AS "orders.customer",
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN orders.ordered_at >= CAST('2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        AND orders.ordered_at < CAST('2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS TIMESTAMP)
        THEN orders.subtotal
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS "orders.iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_5aa1dcc7_btotal_0_sum"
  FROM orders AS orders
  GROUP BY
    orders.customer
), __slayer_stage_per_cust AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."customers.id" AS "id",
    _stage_inner."customers.tweets_2025" AS "tweets_2025",
    _stage_inner."customers.orders_2025" AS "orders_2025",
    _stage_inner."customers.subtotal_2025" AS "subtotal_2025"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      _base_2."customers.id",
      _cm_customers__tweets__iif_tweeted_at_2025_01_01_00_536f3dbe_0_00_1_0_sum."tweets.iif_tweeted_at_2025_01_01_00_536f3dbe_0_00_1_0_sum" AS "customers.tweets_2025",
      _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_69aa264b_0_00_1_0_sum."orders.iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_69aa264b_0_00_1_0_sum" AS "customers.orders_2025",
      _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_5aa1dcc7_btotal_0_sum."orders.iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_5aa1dcc7_btotal_0_sum" AS "customers.subtotal_2025"
    FROM _base_2
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__tweets__iif_tweeted_at_2025_01_01_00_536f3dbe_0_00_1_0_sum
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__tweets__iif_tweeted_at_2025_01_01_00_536f3dbe_0_00_1_0_sum."tweets.user_id"
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_69aa264b_0_00_1_0_sum
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_69aa264b_0_00_1_0_sum."orders.customer"
    LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_5aa1dcc7_btotal_0_sum
      ON _base_2."customers.id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__iif_ordered_at_2025_01_01_00_5aa1dcc7_btotal_0_sum."orders.customer"
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN per_cust.tweets_2025 > 0 THEN 'tweeted' ELSE 'did not tweet' END AS "per_cust.segment",
  COUNT(*) AS "per_cust.customers",
  SUM(per_cust.orders_2025) AS "per_cust.orders",
  SUM(per_cust.subtotal_2025) / NULLIF(SUM(per_cust.orders_2025), 0) / 100.0 AS "per_cust.aov"
FROM __slayer_stage_per_cust AS per_cust
WHERE
  per_cust.orders_2025 > 0
GROUP BY
  CASE WHEN per_cust.tweets_2025 > 0 THEN 'tweeted' ELSE 'did not tweet' END
ORDER BY
